articleTitle: Weight Dropout for Preventing Neural Networks from Overfitting
abstract: This paper briefly introduces an enhanced neural network regularization method, so called weight dropout, in order to prevent deep neural networks from overfitting. In suggested method, the fully connected layer jointly used with weight dropout is a collection of layers in which the weights between nodes are dropped randomly on the process of training. To accomplish the desired regularization method, we propose a building blocks with our weight dropout mask and CNN. The performance of proposed method has been compared with other previous methods in the domain of image classification and segmentation for the evaluation purpose. The results show that the proposed method gives successful performance accuracies in several datasets.

articleTitle: Occlusion Resistant Face Detection and Recognition System
abstract: The application of face recognition has become more and more popular with the development of deep learning algorithms and the calculation of hardware chips for accelerating neural networks. In face recognition, the recognition accuracy is easily affected by light, distance and occlusion. However, the occlusion is the most difficult issue to deal with. This work presents a convolutional neural network which was trained to improve the accuracy of face detection with the ability to capture facial features. The proposed method overcomes the situation when the face accompany with occlusion. All of the face regions and facial landmark are calculated via the face detection network for the inputted image. The face is then aligned by facial landmark and input into the face recognition network for identification. The experimental results of accuracy could reach 96.15% and 88.46% with the occlusion ration 25% and 50%, respectively. The proposed system successfully improves the face recognition accuracy while the face is occluded.

articleTitle: Fault Detection In Photovoltaic Systems Using Machine Learning Algorithms: A Review
abstract: The power produced by photovoltaic systems have great importance in the current global market. From small-scale applications to self-sufficient industries PV systems are planted for the generation and distribution of power. The main factors that need to be considered when setting up a PV plant are safety, cost efficiency and early fault detection techniques. This review work displays the various types of faults seen in PV systems and briefs about the intelligent machine learning algorithms that are built to detect and classify these faults. Furthermore, with the extensive literature, this paper reviews various types of faults detected using different machine learning algorithms in photovoltaic systems which are shown to be reliable and effective to be implemented. The research work is not only bounded to reviewing the fault types with regard to the machine learning algorithms but also talks about 1)Types of PV system, 2)Health state estimation, 3)Fault types, 4)AC/DC side fault, 5)Integration Complexity, 6)Accuracy, 7)Cost of realization. In conclusion, this study is disclosed to share all the valuable information to the scholars working in the field of photovoltaic systems.

articleTitle: Real-time Object Detection of Retail Products for Eye Tracking
abstract: Object detection is one important task in automatically analyzing eye tracking video data. This paper presents a real-time object detection method of retail products based on deep learning for eye tracking system. In the proposed approach, an eye tracking based Convolutional Neural Networks is constructed to obtain the feature of original images. Then, a weighted bounding box selection strategy based on gaze location is used for object detection. Besides, parameters are adjusted according to gaze location of eye tracking. Experimental results show that our method can achieve better accuracy for eye tracking than other existing methods in the detection of retail products.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Teaching Quality Assessment System based on Analytic Hierarchy Process Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation method
abstract: For improving the learning quality, the higher education institutions use the Teaching Quality Assessment(TQA) system to realize the teaching effectiveness via collecting the students' feedbacks. How to correctly use the TQA to indicate the teaching effectiveness is the main research challenge in this time. In this paper, we proposed a TQA System based on Analytic Hierarchy Process Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation method (AHP-FCEM) to find the deeper meaning from the TQA data, The TQA system can transform the subjective scoring into quantitative analysis automatically. The AHP-FCEM ensured the accuracy and efficiency of the quantitative analysis. The steps of AHP-FCEM include determining the evaluation index system, establishing the evaluation set, calculating the evaluation index weight, establishing the comprehensive evaluation matrix and calculating the comprehensive score. Our TQA system was implemented by Python, HTML5 and Django MVC framework. However, our approach are still limited by the TQA moment to only represent the short-term effect.

articleTitle: An attendance system design based on RFID technology
abstract: This paper presented a design scheme of attendance system based on RFID technology. The system used Arduino, MRFC522 and WIFI to design the network card reader. The system stored data through Access database, and designed the upper computer program by the LabVIEW 2016. The system realized the record, query and background management of staff attendance data. Through the attendance system, the enterprise can timely understand the attendance of employees, facilitate the management and assessment of employees. The system had the advantages of low cost, simple operation, simple interface and easy maintenance.

articleTitle: Temperature Rise Test on Medium Voltage Switchgear Assembly Based on IEC Standard
abstract: IEC 62271-1 clause 6.5.2 states the measured temperature difference between the main circuit and the temporary test connections at a distance of 1 m should not exceed 5 K. In order to verify this technical aspect, a temperature rise test is conducted. Several arrangements are made with respect to the standard before the test is executed. Medium voltage (MV) vacuum insulated switchgear is selected for the test and the thermocouple method is implemented. The incomer busbar contacts, vacuum circuit breaker finger contacts, busbar compartment as well as the circuit breaker compartment are the thermocouple points. When the test is executed, 5 A of current from the load bank is fed onto the incomer. The current then flowed through the conductors and contacts of the switchgear which caused heat to be generated. This in turn caused the switching device to experience a temperature rise, especially on the thermocouple points. To measure the temperature, digital thermometers are used and the duration of this test is seven hours. The results are analysed after the test and the implication of the results are made. In the conclusion section, a set of recommendation is provided for the improvement of this project.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition based on Acceleration sensor and Neural Network
abstract: Human activity recognition is widely used in medical treatment, safety, entertainment and so on. To obtain the behavior information of human activity efficiently and accurately, a personal activity behavior recognition method based on acceleration sensor and neural network is proposed. This method records sensor data and labels on STM32 data acquisition device with the help of smartphone/tablet APP. The NN model is trained by using the common data set and the log created by ourselves. With the help of STM32 CubeMx.AI development tool, the model trained by neural network is imported into STM32 firmware to realize low-power MCU classification and recognition of individual jogging, stationary, walking, standing, stairs behavior characteristics. The experimental results show that this method can effectively detect the characteristic parameters of individual activities and can accurately identify the five typical human activities.

articleTitle: Forecasting COVID-19 Cases using Multiple Statistical Models
abstract: An epidemic of respirational sickness triggered by a different coronavirus. Throughout the duration of an outbreak when the individual-to-individual transmission is traditional and testified subjects of coronavirus sickness ‘COVID-19’ are intensifying globally. Predicting is of extreme significance for medic-care devising and regulation the disease with the inadequate property. For the sake of prediction, in this paper, we have used the arithmetic equations with different growth rates along with Linear regression and the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model (ARIMA). The used methods for calculating the growth rates are different in every four cases. For ARIMA, the constraints are predicted by ACF and PACF correlogram. Simulated results show a better performance for each model.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Medical Field
abstract: Artificial intelligence is an interdisciplinary subject with very high comprehensiveness. It is a new and emerging discipline that integrates new technologies, new theories and new ideas. Currently artificial intelligence has been widely applied in many fields, including the field of medical health. This paper expounds the application of artificial intelligence in the field of medical health, analyzes existing problems, and from the perspective of the overall development of the industry, puts forward some suggestions on rational application development of artificial intelligence in the medical field.

articleTitle: Analysis Of E-Commerce System In Marketplace (Shopee Indonesia)
abstract: The purpose of writing this paper is to analyze the e-commerce system on the largest online shopping site in Indonesia, Shopee. co.id. The analysis includes, the advantages and disadvantages of Shopee Indonesia and SWOT analysis on the site. Analysis result shows that Shopee Indonesia is able to become the largest online shopping company in Indonesia with a variety of service advantages and transaction security guarantees. However, Shopee also still has some weaknesses, including regarding the security system, with many consumers still experiencing fraud. Shopee company Indonesia uses inovation strategies and bargaining power of consumers and suppliers to make it the largest online shopping company in Indonesia.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Development of Smart Grid in China
abstract: With the development of smart grid in China as the main line in the new era, the domestic and international environment, strategy and technical route of smart grid development are explored. Firstly, the development status of China's smart grid is analyzed in depth. In addition, the construction of China's smart grid industry and the development of industry chain are elaborated. Finally, the development trend is summarized and the future development pattern of China's smart grid is prospected.

articleTitle: Arbitrary Axis-aligned and Multi-scale Drug Recognition System
abstract: Medication safety has been a important research in many decays. If there is a mistake in the process of packaging medicines, it may cause great harm to patients. This research is aimed at the development of automatic drug image verification functions. Our system is composed of two stages. The first stage is arbitrary axis-aligned object detector, which is mainly based on deep residual network and feature pyramid network(FPN). The detector predicts the rotation bounding boxes for drugs by multi-scale feature maps generated by FPN. Then, the rotation bounding boxes are axially aligned, and the drug image is cropped according to axis-aligned bounding box. The second stage is feature matcher, which is based on feature embedding network. The embedding feature extracted by feature embedding network is combined with the geometric feature obtained by arbitrary axis-aligned object detector to determine whether the drug in image is belonging to expected category that user specify. Our system can detect multiscale rotating drugs and can identify drugs at any position, angle, and placement surface. And due to the addition of geometric features, it can effectively identify drugs with similar appearance but different sizes. Finally, according to the experimental results, a high accuracy rate of 0.047% FAR can be obtained.

articleTitle: Design on Modeling of Multimodal Depression Aided Diagnosis from Psychological Perspective
abstract: The pervasive hopelessness and high risk of suicide in depressive patients suggested that the self might be abnormal among them. Current state-of-the-art depression diagnostic methods include on the basis of an interview style assessment between a clinician and a patient, patient self-reporting, and typical rating scales. However, these tests are subjective and single in nature, low diagnostic accuracy and lack an objective predictor of depression. Therefore, in order to enhance current diagnostic methods, an objective screening mechanism based on physiological and behavioral signals is needed. Learning from previous relevant research and preliminary experimental result, a range of acoustic features have already been identified for applying to the classification of depression. The current project will systematically address above issue, by focusing on abnormalities of self-related processing in patients with unipolar depressive disorder and healthy controls. On the basis of multimodal data acquisition, we will utilize accurate and sophisticated ways of feature extraction and fusion to develop a depression classification model. We present a method of combining the deep learning algorithm with classical psychological experiment technology, which improves the accuracy recognition and provides an objective basis for clinical diagnosis. The result will not only provide new evidence and support for studies on abnormalities of self-related processing in depression via multimodal analysis, but also lay a solid foundation for enriching the diagnosis of depression.

articleTitle: Increasing IS Security using Risk Management on Fintech
abstract: With good engineering, information can be assets that will be value the organization especially in financial technology industry. But with the growth of technology, the threat of information system come in many ways that will destructive directly and indirectly. Uang Teman is and organization that provide peer to peer lending services in financial technology industry. Information system security is very important for Uang Teman to make business strategy and to run the business. However, there are no standard operational procedure for information systems security and accurate incident risk handling that has been implemented at Uang Teman. The objective of this study is to assess and mitigate the risks to existing information system security using NISP, study literature review and observation as its methodology. This study resulting ways to improve information system security for financial technology industry and a way to reduce the occurrence of information system security threats.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Automated Problem Categorization in a Helpdesk Ticketing Application
abstract: To handle internal complaints, some companies have implemented a helpdesk system while some other processes are still carried out manually. The helpdesk ticket is categorized manually by human operators. This procedure prone to be an error resulting in many tickets bounced to the wrong business unit and delaying the complaint handling. In this study, an automated problem categorization based on the title of helpdesk ticketing using machine learning is studied. The results show that the random forest classification has the highest accuracy value of 82%.

articleTitle: Model Design of Teachers' Curriculum Teaching Happiness Improvement System in Higher Vocational Colleges
abstract: This paper systematically studies the influencing factors of teachers' curriculum teaching happiness in higher vocational colleges, and provides a theoretical model and implementation path for the government education department and higher vocational colleges to improve curriculum teaching level and teachers' happiness. Three dimensions and eight influencing factors of the improvement of teachers' curriculum teaching happiness in higher vocational colleges were established respectively. Eight influential factors were analyzed and evaluated by fuzzy AHP, and the weights of the influencing factors were sorted to design the model of teachers' curriculum teaching happiness improvement system. According to the weight of each influencing factor in the evaluation of curriculum teaching happiness, from the three dimensions of teaching environment, teaching subject and influence of teaching, the methods and measures for improving the happiness of curriculum teaching are proposed, which provides a useful reference for the construction of curriculums teaching quality and the improvement of teachers' happiness in government education departments and higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of the Training Effect of Disaster Medicine Emergency Course based on Apriori Association Rule Analysis
abstract: It is an important work to provide the enough training to support the related personnels to facing a disaster emergency challenge. In 2015, the Basic Disaster Life Support (BDLS) and Advanced Disaster Life Support (ADLS) courses in the National Disaster Life Support (NDLS) courses were introduced to China. After the localization from 2015 to 2017, the BDLS/ADLS has been reformed. In this work, this NDLS localization effect has been studied. At first, this study uses data mining technology to analyze the training effect. Then use the Apriori association rule analysis method to find the influencing factors of the NDLS course training effect. In summary, NDLS training currently has achieved a certain scale, the training effect is essentially remarkable, and the satisfaction of the trainees is high in China. The NDLS localization can satisfy the current needs at this stage.

articleTitle: Optimization of Human Body Attitude Detection Based on Mask RCNN
abstract: Mask RCNN has the advantage of higher accuracy than other human body attitude detection models, and has been widely used for multi-person human body attitude detection. However, Mask RCNN has a low detection speed. Therefore, we propose a MobileNet-based Mask RCNN optimization model to accelerate the inference calculation speed of Mask RCNN. At the same time, in order to further improve the detection accuracy of Mask RCNN, we propose a method by using pixel segmentation results to assist the detection of key points in the human body, which improves the speed of reasoning and reduces the rate of false detection to some extent.

articleTitle: Application of Multiple BERT Model in Construction Litigation
abstract: More and more AI technologies are used in law, but there are few legal staff with knowledge of construction engineering. This study uses deep learning technology based on multiple BERT model to propose a construction litigation judgment prediction system. The system has two functions: 1. Find similar cases. 2. Court judgment prediction. In similar cases calculation, the text is vectorized through the word embedding model. Then, each word is weighted by IDF and part of speech (POS) and the cosine similarity is calculated. Finally, the top 10 similar cases are listed. The court judgment prediction result is to use the multiple BERT model to vectorize the plaintiff's claim and then pass the neural network to predict the result of the court judgment. The multiple BERT model solves the problem that cannot be used for long text. The average precision at 10 in similar cases calculation is 0.911. The accuracy rate in predicting litigation period and the gain in the litigation is 88.89% and 82.22%.

articleTitle: Shellfish Recognition Based on Gabor Transformation and Principal Component Analysis
abstract: In this paper, a method of shellfish recognition based on Gabor transform and two-dimensional image principal component analysis (2DPCA) is studied. Gabor transform is used to extract the image features and determine the dimension of the image features; The 2DPCA method is used to reduce the dimension of the transformed features. Compared with BP neural network and support vector machine (SVM) experiments, the results shows that the extreme learning machine classifier is very fast, which has good generalization and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Mitigating Sparsity and Cold Start Problem in Collaborative Filtering using Cross-domain Similarity
abstract: Collaborative filtering (CF) has proven to be the most prominent and preferable approach in the recommendation systems due to its simplicity and effectiveness. The fundamental philosophy of CF-based recommendation is that similar users have the same rating patterns and similar items obtain similar ratings. However, the accuracy of CF significantly degrades when the dataset becomes highly sparse due to the unavailability of sufficient rating information of a user. The existing similarity measures have not been able to cope up this problem that very well, and this has been the motivation of this paper, in which we aim to improve the performance of collaborative filtering by utilizing the rating information of common users who belong to multiple domains. This approach can albeit both the sparsity (inadequate rating information) and the cold start (no rating information at all) problems. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is examined with the Amazon dataset and the experimental results show that the proposed approach attains high accuracy than the existing CF-based recommendation approaches.

articleTitle: Data-Specific Activation Function Learning for Hyperspectral Image Classification
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification plays an important role in lots of HSI analysis related tasks. In recent years, deep learning based methods draw much attention for HSI classification due to the powerful representation ability. The activation function is essential for deep learning based methods since it introduces nonlinearity into the network. However, existing activation functions such as Sigmoid and ReLU are pre-defined, which are handcrafted and general for any kinds of data. If they fit well to a specific dataset and thus lead to best classification result is seldom studied. In this paper, we propose to learn a specific data-driven function called data-specific (DS) activation function for HSI classification. Instead of using a hand-crafted function, we propose an HSI oriented activation function generation strategy, in which neural network (NN) architecture is utilized to learn the activation function suitable for HSI classification. Experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned activation function for HSI classification.

articleTitle: Business Process Management for Startup in Indonesia
abstract: The rapid growth of startup companies is also accompanied by the large number of startup companies failing to survive. Based on industry standards, 9 out of 10 startup companies experienced a failure which was largely due to poor management of the company and lack of funding. This paper aims to show a standard model that can be used by startup companies to anticipate future failures. The method used in building this model is to apply the basic concept of a Business Process Model (BPM) that is adapted to the climate of development of startup companies. This article will also show some elements of BPM that will try to be implemented in one of the technology startup companies engaged in education and social affairs. The element will be complemented by an explanation as a form of integration of the BPM concept, the climate of development of the startup company and its relevance as a good model for the development of startup companies. In the future, it is hoped that this model can be used as a reference for other startup companies to face the challenges of startup companies failure.

articleTitle: A Study on Children's Choice Preference of 3-6 Years Old for Intelligent Development Games
abstract: Intelligent development games can stimulate children's curiosity, develop children's creativity, imagination and other abilities, and play an indispensable role in children's growth. Relevant literature in the past shows that most scholars' research on intelligent development games is based on the classification and educational value of intelligent development games, and there is very little research on the selection preference of intelligent development games. Through questionnaire surveys, this research explores the choices and preferences of children aged 3-6 for intelligent development games, understands the true preferences and intellectual development needs of children aged 3-6, and provides a factual basis for more scientifically launching intelligent development games.

articleTitle: Identification of E-Commerce Business Approaches to Improve Customer Satisfaction
abstract: In the current modern era, the use of the internet to fulfill living needs is not a stranger. The internet has become a primary need for all humans without exception like gender, age and other factors. One of the activities using the internet that is starting to get crowded is shopping. A few decades before, shopping was needed to visit the store directly physically. Now, we don't need to know where the store is because it has been brokered by a website called e-commerce. Even in 2016, the study said there were 8.7 million users who used e-commerce in shopping. One of the famous e-commerce sites is bukalapak. Bukalapak is a unicorn in Indonesia where the technology company is considered to have unusual ideas and solutions with a valuation of more than US $ 1 billion. one of Bukalapak's successes in its business is close relationships with users. Therefore, with this paper we will discuss the success of Bukalapak in building relationships with its users.

articleTitle: IS Strategic Planning Development Based on Unifled Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology Analysis Result
abstract: PT. XXX is one of the companies in Indonesia engaged in the one stop logistics field which has been working for more than 30 years and located in South Jakarta. The current conditions at that company do not have a good Information Systems strategy, less use of Information Systems use and the company only makes a work plan based on the project plan to be taken. Therefore, PT. XXX requires an IS Strategic Planning using Enterprise Architecture. Before implementing the warehouse management system at company, first analyze the readiness of the implementation of the warehouse management system by distributing questionnaires to 200 employee respondents. The model used for this study uses Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) Theory. The purpose of this study is look for indicators, and new factors which will later be used to build a new model based on the results of the respondent questionnaire. from the theory model developed into a new model that will form new factors and indicators. From the some factors used then the data the results of the questionnaire processed using factor analysis resulted in 5 new factors, namely, after obtaining 5 new factors, then processed into a new model that has been analyzed using linear regression.

articleTitle: Entrepreneur of Internet of Things (IoT) in Portable Hydroponic
abstract: Smart farming is a combination of technology such as the Internet of Things (IoT) with farming to produce a better product. Supported by the internet, the Internet of Things (IoT) could send data to a device and process command from a device like a mobile app. As experts have predicted that in the future a crisis will show up, where land or area for farming will decrease while the demands of supply will increase, the need to find an alternative in farming shows up. The hydroponic technique is one of the alternatives that could be taken. By combining the hydroponic technique with smart farming, the crisis could be evaded. The proposed idea obtained from this paper is to make an application connected a portable hydroponic device. Which the idea of it could be turned into a possible business in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Virtual Reality Insects Learning System with Its User Experience Evaluation
abstract: This work proposed a Virtual Reality Insects Learning System for elementary school students. Since the application of Virtual Reality has been gradually involved into education recently, the investigation of the effect and its usefulness could be an interesting topic for both content provider and teachers. The proposed work includes fifteen different kinds of insects with individual explanation; students can interact with the system to learn to know each insect. The proposed system is further used to evaluate students' learning experience and perceptions. The experimental results show that students perceived positive motivation and attitudes accompany with less cognitive load in Virtual Reality learning. The results of this work also demonstrate that the Virtual Reality related content provide a brand new learning experience which is helpful for students' study.

articleTitle: Visible Light Communication Coding Method Based on EAN-8
abstract: A novel EAN-8 coding method of visible light communication is proposed. Coding evaluation system include a normal led panel light. The experimental results show that barcode scanning APP can recognize the light barcode accurately. All these show that the new method is effective and has high practical value.

articleTitle: Control of Chaotic Nonlinear Systems Using RBF Network with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, a intelligent RBF neural network (RBFNN) tracking control system with reinforcement learning (RL) compensation methods control technique is proposed for a class of chaos systems. The proposed adaptive control scheme is developed for a class of chaotic systems with unknown bounded uncertainties. The adaptation laws are derived using a gradient descent, so that both system tracking stability and error convergence can be guaranteed in the closed-loop system. It are used to demonstrate the effectiveness and performance of proposed hybrid control technique.

articleTitle: Building Healthy Ageing: The Dynamics of Self-fulfillment in Old Age
abstract: This study examines the achievement of self-fulfillment in the conceptualization of good old age by providing theoretical and cultural implications for elder's technology development. The method employed interviews with 30 people aged from 70 to 80. The findings show the relationship and dynamics in the self-fulfillment process, drawing on a research conceptual framework and propositions for the future development and study in aging issues. A more comprehensive framework and the future development of wellbeing toward elderly is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Medical Information Resource Sharing System Based on Cloud Computing
abstract: In order to realize information resources sharing, taking Wujin District of Changzhou City hospitals for example, an information resource sharing model based on cloud computing is proposed which aim to integrate the high-quality medical resources to promote the management and sharing of medical resources in hospitals. The advantages of system are discussed and the system can be a reference for information sharing of other regions.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Voice Food Ordering System
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of Internet applications, online food ordering systems can make people's lives more convenient. However, how to choose the favorite food among various foods conveniently has become the focus of the development of online food ordering systems. Due to the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology and popularization of intelligent applications, more and more intelligent systems have been proposed. However, artificial intelligence exploiting both speech recognition and semantic understanding technology is rarely used to develop intelligent food ordering systems. We hereby propose the intelligent voice food ordering system (IVFOS), which is designed and implemented on the basis of Iflytek AIUI platform, combining speech recognition and semantic understanding technology so as to make the food ordering more convenient. We have further introduced a personalized recommendation mechanism to serve customers based on their historical ordering records. The practical application shows that our intelligent voice food ordering system has the characteristics of convenient usage and highly personalized food ordering experience.

articleTitle: An Efficient Data Collection and Analysis System for Teaching Evolution
abstract: How to effectively and efficiently evaluate learning quality in the higher education institutions has become one very important issue. The teaching quality assessment (TQA) is one of the measures to improve the teachers' learning activities planning and organization. In the past, the assessment from the students' feedback is not enough to more general and comprehensive evaluate the teaching quality. For supporting the administrators and non-administrators peer review, we proposed a total teaching quality assessment system. The TQA system has implemented and used in CCIT, China.

articleTitle: The design of 3S data comprehensive application payload of Micro-nano satellite
abstract: Micro-nano satellites have been applied in various fields successfully, and more and more attention is paid to payload mission orientation. The multi-function and integration of payload is the development trend of micro-nana satellite payload technology. Through the design of antenna integration and software radio generalized platform, the 3S data Integrated application payload has become a new one, which integrates three source of reception data, including the airborne ADS-B signals, the GNSS-R sea face signals and the ship AIS signals. This payload can reduce the volume, weight and power consumption significantly, which can satisfy the requirement of the micro-nana satellite platform of carrying.

articleTitle: On the Development of Continuing Education Technology in an Aging Society
abstract: Under the background of accelerating the aging process, the sustainable development of continuing education technology is of great significance to improve the level of economic development and the overall quality of the elderly workers, and to achieve healthy aging. In the process of aging society, there are many difficulties in the management system, teaching resources, education mode, teaching form and teaching content of continuing education technology. Therefore, we can improve the technology of continuing education from two aspects: one is to strengthen propaganda, raise awareness, straighten out management system, increase investment in funds and improve laws and regulations; the other is to broaden teaching content, strengthen the construction of teachers, reform teaching methods and means at the institutional level to promote aging.

articleTitle: Preprocessing and Characteristic Statistics of Blood Cell Images Based on Delphi
abstract: Aiming at how to effectively extract characteristic indicators from the blood cell morphology map, so as to determine the nature of such cell morphology, and distinguish it from other cell morphology patterns to estimate whether the cell has pathological changes. Cell image is preprocessed by chromaticity interval method, binarization, contour acquisition, cell segmentation, defect filling and noise removal, and then the region marker of cell color difference is used to calculate the compactness of its characteristic parameters and the position of its center of gravity. Through automatic processing of Delphi program, statistical data can be provided as an important basis for pathological diagnosis.

articleTitle: Digital Batik Museum Website Design using User Centred Design (UCD) Method
abstract: At present the use of batik is more focused as a fashion that has unique motifs with high artistic value. But the history of batik is not widely known by the public because of the difficulty of getting clear information about the meaning of a batik motif. So, in this study the authors propose to create a digital batik museum website design using the User Centered Design method that is focused on the user with persona tools as a support. the results of this design are expected to help the user in learning information about batik.

articleTitle: Robot as an Constructive Learning Tool for Computer Programming: the Practices in Taiwan
abstract: How to effectively and efficiently train enough programmer has become a very important issue to the education system. In tradition, the computer programming training is an part of the undergraduate program in the universities. In the 21st century, the computer programming training is subsumed under the K12 curriculum, especially the high school stage, in more and more countries. But in the high school stage, the students are still without enough abstract thinking ability and mathematical/logical training. How to design the computer programming learning contents and activities for the high school students is still a difficult challenge. In this paper, we propose a constructive learning experiment in Taiwan, which use the robot as a concrete tool in order to introduce computer programming to the high school students. We expect the concrete experience can reduce the influence of abstract thinking scantiness.

articleTitle: A Prototype of Smart Lock based on Internet of Things for Logistics Safety
abstract: Because of the dramatic development of the B2C e-commerces, the logistics safety has become more and more important. In this paper, we tried to propose a prototype of smart lock to ensure the safety in the shipping process. The prototype of smart lock is based on the IOT technology. The smart lock is set for the only specific customer's smart phone to unlock it. And the unlocked times is recorded and shown to the customer. This prototype is implemented via the ESP8266 MCU with the NFC function. The smart lock is supported by the MQTT server on the cloud.

Author Keywords: Smart Lock Internet of Things Logistics safety

articleTitle: Mobile Light Spots Detection and Tracking of Vehicle Target in Dim Light Environment
abstract: This paper focuses on the detection and tracking of mobile light spots in dim light environment, and the pixel discrimination method and morphological matching method are proposed. The image sensor installed on the vehicle is used as the acquisition unit. The mobile light spots recognition in dim light environment and the dynamic tracking detection of moving and static targets are carried out to realize the mobile light spots recognition based on intelligent image perception technology. At the same time, the open source function library of OpenCV is used to study the system of detecting and recognizing the characteristics of night lights in C++ environment. The results show that the detection and tracking of mobile light spots can effectively capture and recognize the spot.

articleTitle: Research on the Value of the Construction of Intelligent Sports Park for Perfecting Public Sports Service System
abstract: This article revolves around the contents of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party and General Secretary Xi Jinping on sports power, national fitness, social conflicts, sports public service system, artificial intelligence, etc., and analyzes and summarizes the successful experiences of domestic intelligent sports parks. Therefore, the value of the intelligent sports park in improving the public service system is summarized.

articleTitle: Emulating 1-wire EEPROM Chip in Surgical Robot Instrument System based on Microprocessor
abstract: This paper researches a 1-wire EEPROM emulator in surgical robot instrument system to convenient the surgical robot system installation and testing. The research has realized the emulation of response sequence of single-bus slave and EEPROM read/write function with single-chip microcomputer. It solves the problem that EEPROM lithography cannot be copied and can be applicable to other single-bus devices. The experimental results show that 1-wire slave emulator has high response accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Service-Oriented Integration of Hospital Application System
abstract: An integration platform solution of existing hospital information system based on Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) is proposed. The whole system is designed and combined with the loosely coupled subsystem through Web Service, and finally integrated into an organic whole organization with multiple functions. The problem of information heterogeneity, geographic distribution and isolation among management systems of various hospital departments is solved, which is helpful for organizing complex data interaction interface, greatly improving the efficiency of data exchange and forming a standardized interface platform of hospitals that is easy to be controlled and managed.

articleTitle: Design of a problem-based curriculum: A constructive approach for Mobile APP Learning
abstract: It has became possible and realistic due to more bandwidth provided by mobile communication that anyone can access the Internet anywhere and anytime, even he/she is in moving. The mobile application, denoted as APP, integrating the computing power of clouds and the mobility of smart-phones, changes the modern living of humans totally, and provides more comfort and convenience. As the APP has been more important, the demand of APP programmers has also been more strong. This paper proposes a work which trains the undergraduate students to develop the mobile APP via a constructive problem-based approach. It is a one-semesters course project. The study basically shows the effectiveness of the proposed approach and the expectation of the students.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data in Improving College Students'Happiness
abstract: The scientific application of big data technology can significantly improve college students'well-being, combine big data with student safety management, form student safety database, combine big data with student life service, form student life database, combine big data with student learning, and form student safety database. Academic database. If students' safety data, life data and academic data are collected and analyzed effectively, it can become a platform for diagnosis and improvement of students' work.

articleTitle: A New Design for Video Marketing under the New Agribusiness Model
abstract: The new agribusiness model is increasingly becoming a favorite business startup platform in rural areas, which consequently boost the online sales of farm products. The analysis on the marketing goal and value of this model leads to the design of an approach via short videos and live online platforms to fulfill the sales target. This approach will, therefore, better guide the agriculture business startup projects through implementing standards and methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Situation and Development Trend of Live Webcasting of Important Space Missions
abstract: In recent years, the world's space science and technology, represented by China and the United States, has developed by leaps and bounds. Webcast of important space missions has rapidly become a new phenomenon on the Internet by virtue of non-linear communication, empathy communication and bringing lofty aesthetic experience. However, the simplification of its manifestation and the instability of its launch window make its further development encounter bottlenecks. Furthermore, the emergence of commercial space mode makes China's live space broadcasting become a consumer image symbol, and originally serious and high-risk space activities are gradually becoming spectacles. In the time of media integration, the application of 5G and other future media technologies may reshape the webcast of space missions and spread space culture to the public.

articleTitle: Constructing Legacy and Self-Fulfillment in Aging Process: A Chinese insight
abstract: This research explores how a sense of legacy and self-fulfillment contributes to a sense of good old age. Based on a Chinese cultural context in Taiwan, we interview elderly people aged 60 to 80. Our research results show that under the traditional Chinese culture, the sense of legend about the continuation of personal life is unique tp Chinese culture in which the self-legacy and self-realization identified in this research are shown in the liberation of the individual self and family-child groups, rather than limiting the specific completion of the current limited life of the individual at an advanced age. The finding shed light on happiness of good old age and help to inspire the future education and value of senior citizens. Implications of these findings to a cultural challenge of good old age are discussed.

articleTitle: The Neural Sliding-Mode Control with Actor-Critic for Nonlinear System
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the RBF sliding-mode control (RBFSMC) with actor-critic compensation methods tracking control system is proposed for nonlinear systems. The proposed adaptive control scheme is developed for nonlinear systems with unknown bounded uncertainties. The adaptation laws are derived using a gradient descent, so that both system tracking stability and error convergence can be guaranteed in the closed-loop system. It was used to demonstrate the effectiveness and performance of proposed unite control technique.

articleTitle: Transregional Institutional Learning between NingXia and Taiwan: A Higher Vocational Education Experiment
abstract: Since 1990s, vocational education, especially the higher vocational education, has become more important in the industrialized societies. Furthermore, the higher vocational education has been considered as a policy tool to reduce the unemployment rate. The decision-maker of higher education must balanced the various needs in the program design according to the targeting and positioning of the university. This paper proposed an higher vocational education experiment, transregional institutional learning between the NingXia Polytechnic in NingXia and the Tajen University in Taiwan. Two groups of students are selected to the one-semester learning program in Taiwan. In this semester, these student can realize and experience the practical and industry-oriented learning activities in Taiwan higher vocational education. In addition, the teachers of NingXia Polytechnic joint the industry-university collaborative project in the Tajen university. This collaboration among teachers has still continued after 2018. These teachers of NingXia Polytechnic can clearly realize and learn the industry-university collaborative model in Taiwan higher vocational education.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Neural Network Acoustic Model for Taiwanese Speech Recognition
abstract: Taiwanese is one of the main languages spoken by Taiwanese. Taiwanese was commonly used language in Taiwan before, but now it is facing the dilemma of declining. Therefore, maintaining traditional culture in the ever-changing trend is a major issue. In this study, we developed the Taiwanese speech recognition system which the Kaldi Toolkit was used to implement. The Taiwanese corpus was collected by Taiwan Taiwanese National Reading Competition and Classmate Recording, and about 11 hours of audio files were collected in total. Because the training data is a small dataset, two data augmentation methods are used to increase the training data, so that the acoustic model can be more robust and more effective training. One method is speed perturbation, which speeds up the original data by 1.1 times and slows it down by 0.9 times. Another method is to use multi-condition training data to simulate the reverberation of the original speech and add background noise. The background noise includes music, speech, and noise. The acoustic model is trained for different hybrid deep neural network architectures which can use the advantages of each neural network by hybrid different neural networks, such as CNN-LSTM-TDNN. In the experimental results, the CER in the domain of language modeling reaches 3.95%, and the CER of the online decoding test is 3.06%. Compared with other research on Taiwanese speech recognition of similar dataset size, the recognition results are better than other studies.

articleTitle: Decision Analysis of Nuclear Power Investment Development under Carbon Price
abstract: Based on the real option theory, this paper made a decision analysis on China's nuclear power generation investment projects. The model considered the investment cost of nuclear power projects, fixed costs, electricity prices and carbon prices. From the perspective of power generation enterprises, modeling and analyzing the value of enterprise investment nuclear power projects, and added market linkage in the model. In the scenario simulation, the Monte Carlo least squares method was used to simulate the project option value, so as to obtain the option value of the project, and the actual investment value of the nuclear power project was analyzed from the perspective of options. Then the impact of investment cost, electricity price, carbon price and fixed cost on the investment value of the project was analyzed separately. Research shows that under the existing nuclear power investment environment in China, the investment value of enterprises investing in nuclear power is negative, and enterprises will not invest in nuclear power projects. However, in the case of falling investment costs and rising carbon dioxide trading prices, the investment value of nuclear power projects will become positive, and enterprises will invest in nuclear power projects.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Experiment on SEER Database using Artificial Neural Network
abstract: In the daily of nowadays, cancer has been an important topic during the experts and normals. Due to the high death rate and high cost of healing, it is usually classified as incurable disease. However, with the development of the medic technology, some kinds of the cancers are able to healed. To analyze the result of the disease is a very important part of both clinic and study. In the area of computer science, data mining is a very useful way to analyze the big data. Combine the data from SEER stat, a database of cancer, and data mining algorithms, it is possible to push the result of the disease analyzation.

articleTitle: The Implement of Packet Tracer as UI to Monitor and Control Real IoT Devices
abstract: IoT technologies use sensors and controllers to collect information and control devices vi network and organize as one ecosystem. IoT developer should try many devices and combinations to build a system for smart environment. Cisco Packet Tracer is a powerful network simulation tool to experiment network behavior. Packet Tracer can be a simulation environment for IoT Development, in additional, which provides an API to communicate with real devices. This paper implements the Packet Tracer as user interface(UI) to monitor and control the real word IoT devices.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Designing Conversational Banking Service Architecture for Banking Company
abstract: In the current technological era, companies compete to find new innovations to support the services they offer. Banking companies are constantly developing new innovations for the applications they need to make access and use easier and more practical. Since the chatbot is already widespread in order to be able to answer the information requested by users quickly and easily, this chatbot must be trained to respond more precisely to users. Next up is the well-known voice command that allows users to control applications using voice. This feature is very helpful for application users who are active in a very tight time. The two groundbreaking innovations mentioned above are expected to make loaders competitive in this technological age.

articleTitle: The Design and Application of Photovoltaic Power Generation Systems
abstract: In recent years, the exploitation and application of green energy resources have attracted more and more attention of people. The training room presented is focused on the terminal applications of a photovoltaic power generation system (PPGS). Students can not only learn the composition and the general design principles, but also master the fundamental skills required for its design, installation and construction. The training room consists of numerous platforms, such as: PPGS, Wind and Photovoltaic Hybrid Power Generation System, Wind Power Generation Equipment, Simulative Grid-Connected Power Generation System, Electronic Technology Application of New Energy, etc. This enables the students to receive their project and professional skills training via assembling, adjusting, maintaining and inspecting, etc. various component parts of the photovoltaic and new energy power generation systems, to further grasp the fundamental and related theoretical knowledge, and to further reinforce their practical and operational skills, so as to improve their problem-analyzing and problem-solving abilities.

articleTitle: Avatar Social System on Self-associated Emotional Empathy Perceptions
abstract: Empathy and self-emotional management are important in many area. Appropriate sympathy is critical to the success in such applications. In this study, a self-associated Avatar empathy system was developed with injecting empathic emotion into the self-associated virtual character. We investigated three typical self-associated emotional empathy scenes. And the empathy emotion database was established by labeling empathy emotion of interviewers and interviewees in the CCTV psychological interview program. We found that the self-associated Avatar empathy system was better to encourage positive empathy, which can bring positive health benefits and thus improve the individual's self-emotional management.

articleTitle: Genetic Analysis for Breast Cancer Prediction and Diagnosis
abstract: Breast cancer signifies one of the diseases which contributes to a huge number of deaths each year. It is the most usual kind of cancer and also one of the main reasons for women's deaths globally. In the medical domain, data mining methods and Artificial Intelligence algorithms are used in early prognosis to make decisions. In this paper, we have highlighted the root cause of Breast cancer with the imbalance of Genomes. Also, we have described some of the existing predictions using various algorithms for breast cancer data. Our proposed architecture involves a combination of Artificial Intelligence algorithms and genetic algorithms as we have focused not only on the prediction of Breast cancer but also, included the genetic algorithm for genome sequencing promptly to the identified people, to avoid the stages of Breast cancer with respect to the time of identification. We have predicted the breast cancer genome dataset using some machine learning algorithms, where the Support Vector Machine algorithm gives a prediction accuracy of 61.55%. We are researching and working on the results for identifying the most accurate genetic algorithm to complete the design of a cost-effective model for genome sequencing.

articleTitle: The Performace Evaluation of Knowledge Management Systems Implementation In The Organization
abstract: The purpose of this study is to see how factors of knowledge management, customer relationship management, and employment programs that affect the realization of the Organization's performance against. The methods used in the writing of this thesis is the analysis of the path and also by using the study library for searching for reference materials. The results of the analysis conducted States that there are influences from factors of knowledge management, customer relationship management, and an influential work program towards the realization of the Organization's performance. The existence of this research, then obtained a model of organizational performance.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Mental Health Level of Undergraduates in Northeast China
abstract: Based on the investigation of mental health of undergraduates in Shenyang City University, this paper provides the basis for the research of improving mental health of undergraduates with the help of quantitative research results. This paper reached the following conclusions that the mental health of college students in Northeast China generally needs to be improved, and the score is lower than the national norm of national college students. Moreover, the influence of the variables such as major, gender on the mental health of college students. More attention should be paid to the mental health of boys, especially the boys in science and engineering.

articleTitle: Hierarchy of Shaping a Good Old Age: From Absence of Health Limitation to Mental Healthiness
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore and develop a hierarchy of leveling quality of wellbeing to conceptualize good old age, from staying healthy to mental healthiness. The research method adopts field interview and archive analysis of 30 participants aged from 60 to 80 at Tainan city in Taiwan. The findings show that shaping a good old age has a sequence and every hierarchy are essential conditions in which Absence of serious health limitations is the fundamental condition and having autonomy and being useful, both of which are about mental healthiness. The proposed hierarchy of good old age inspire future advanced research of priority of wellbeing pursuit.

articleTitle: DC-TseNet: A Dual-Channel Time-Domain Speech Enhancement Network
abstract: In this paper, we propose an end-to-end dual-channel time domain speech enhancement approach, named DC-TseNet, for devices with multiple microphones such as mobile phones used in far-filed scenario like teleconferencing. DC-TseNet incorporates a computationally efficient CNN to form a unified encoder-enhancement-decoder structure that learns clean speech directly using multichannel signals. In addition, DC-TseNet is trained from both intra-channel an inter-channel features to express the relevance and difference between the collected signals from the two microphones, which makes sufficient use of spatial information and reduce the influence of recording direction on the signals. The experimental results show that the proposed dual-channel time-domain approach, with more compact model size, significantly outperforms the LSTM-based frequency-domain method. Furthermore, we find that the inter-channel information, especially the difference between two channels, is more important for a better performance gain.

articleTitle: Research on application of various regression prediction models in Wood Composite Products
abstract: This study presents an ensemble of predictive models with a focus on the predictive capabilities of Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART). Predictions are made for Modulus of Rupture (MOR) and Tensile Strength (IB or Internal Bond) from a wood composites manufacturing process for three product types. Given the large number of predictor variables from the process, variable preselection was used prior to model development. Several regression methods including multiple linear regression, partial least squares regression, neural networks, regression trees, boosted trees, and bootstrap forest are compared with BART. BART had the best predictive performance in validation unanimously for both MOR and IB for two of three products examined. Bootstrap forest validation results were very similar to BART for one of the products. BART validation results of MOR were promising for the nominal product type of 15.88 mm with an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r=0.86$</tex> for 10-fold cross validation with root mean square error of prediction (NRMSEP) of 11.89%. BART validation results for IB had an average <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r=0.84$</tex> for 10-fold cross-validation with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{NRMSEP}=10.82{\%}$</tex>. The high predictive ability of BART may be useful for manufacturers and researchers in applying analytical techniques for process improvement leading to less rework (order reruns due to failing properties) and reject. Predictive modeling techniques like the ones explored in this study may be very important to companies seeking competitive advantage in today's business world that is focused on advanced analytics and data mining.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship Between the Frequency Spectrum Characteristics and the Vibration Responses of a Ginkgo biloba Tree
abstract: The most effective method of the fruit harvesting is the mechanical harvest. Under forced vibration, not only the excitation amplitude, frequency, duration, but also the inherent frequency spectrum characteristics of the fruit trees affect the removal of fruits. The frequency spectrum of different testing positions on a Ginkgo biloba tree under the impact excitation was tested in the laboratory. The acceleration responses under the harmonic excitation were measured at the frequency of the peak and trough points in the frequency spectrum curves. Results of this research indicate that the frequency spectrum presented the consistency on the same branch but distinction among different branches. There was a correspondence between the frequency spectrum characteristics and the vibration responses. The vibration responses could be strengthened at the resonant frequency. Our results indicate that it was difficult to induce the strong vibration response of all the branches at the single frequency during the practical mechanical harvesting of fruits.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Semantic Segmentation
abstract: Owing to emergence of Deep Learning (DL) techniques, the segmentation models considerably enhanced their accuracy. However, this improved performance of currently popular DL models for self-driving car applications come at the cost of time and computational efficiency. Moreover, networks with efficient model architecture experience lack of accuracy. Therefore, in this study, we propose an efficient deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) model architecture that combines carefully formulated encoding and decoding paths. Specifically, the contraction path uses mixture of dilated and asymmetric convolution layers with skip connections and bottleneck layers, while the decoding path benefits from nearest neighbor interpolation method that demands no trainable parameters to restore original image size. Owing to the prudently designed model architecture, it considerably reduces the number of trainable parameters, required memory space, training, and inference time. Also, it obtained competitive accuracy scores on several evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Promo Abuse Modeling in E-Commerce Using Machine Learning Approach
abstract: To increase the attractiveness of new customers and customer engagement, e-store makes various promos. However, as faced by XYZ, an e-commerce company based in Indonesia, some of the promos are prone to be misused by some users. A well-known type of abuse is the reduplication of accounts by the same user to get more coupons or promotions fraudulently. This abusive act can bring huge losses to the company, as the promotional campaign will miss the intended targets. The purpose of this study is to examine whether some data mining techniques such as the J48 Algorithm and Random Forest Algorithm can be deployed to detect promo misuse based on available customer's profile. The study uses a dataset from the transaction history recorded by XYZ company during the years 2018 and 2019. The results show that both algorithms can accurately model the FRAUD on the promos where the Random Forest Algorithm obtain a significantly higher level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on House Price Forecast Based on Hyper Parameter Optimization Gradient Boosting Regression Model
abstract: In order to study the prediction accuracy of different regression models, this paper selects housing price prediction as a typical research object, and proposes a hyper parameter optimization gradient boosting regression model (HPOGBR). Firstly, the data is preprocessed and the key features are extracted through visualization and basic model pretraining. Then, multiple machine learning regression models are used for comparison with our HPOGBR model base on evaluation indicators. Finally, the optimal model and parameters are selected by grid search. The experimental results show that our proposed HPOGBR model has better accuracy and convergence over existing machine learning regression models.

articleTitle: Technology Drive Entrepreneurial Digital Business Transformation
abstract: Entrepreneurship technology invests in projects that are linked and heterogeneous assets related to scientific and technological knowledge to create and enhance the company. Lack of knowledge about entrepreneurship technology makes it difficult to make decisions as long as a new business is still not in the shape of an original or old concept. The concept of entrepreneurial technology combines entrepreneurship and technological innovation. The business side of a digital transformation is also attracting a lot of attention, especially from consulting companies. Digital technology in entrepreneurship that comes in new company technology assets can also focus on increasing the company's revenue. Digital business transformation is an application technology that enables to create of new business models, processes, software and systems that result in profitable revenue, increased competitive advantage and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction Models For PT. XYZ Insurance
abstract: High persistence is a major business objective that wants to be achieved by insurance companies. To achieve high persistence, insurance companies need to be able to maintain their customers. Currently, the majority of insurance companies in Indonesia don't have an appropriate system in place to retain their customers. This paper presents an approach using data mining techniques to help such a company in dealing with customer churn. We explore some data mining techniques using real data from PT XYZ, an Indonesian based insurance company. The techniques implemented in this work are supervised learning methods, which are Decision Tree (DT), Naïve Bayes (NB), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). It turns out that DT produces the best result with 91.3111% accuracy and 0.970 of AUC, followed by ANN and NB. With this level of accuracy, it is recommended that PT XYZ Insurance and Indonesian insurance company in general, may use the Decision Tree method for the customer churn prediction model.

articleTitle: Chain Analysis of New Energy Industry in China
abstract: With the development of new energy in China as the main line in the new era, the policies and energy supply situation of China's new energy industry is introduced. The current development status and development strategies and prospects of China's new energy industry is reviewed. Through the upstream and downstream analysis of the new energy industry chain, the market competition pattern of the industry is analyzed. Finally, the feasibility of gradually realizing the localization of the new energy industry chain, the technical level and reliability of equipment, and the industrial scale in the new energy industry are discussed.

articleTitle: Enhanced Prediction for Investment Portfolio Management using Multiple Kernel-based Long Short-Term Memory-Network for Nickel Price Prediction
abstract: Nickel is a key competitive material source with commodities and economic characteristics, the price volatility of which would influence shareholder's decisions. For this reason, an accurate pattern prediction of nickel prices is a crucial concern for the strategic planning of investors in the nickel trade; however, the conventional neural network models are not effective in terms of predictive performance and suitability. So, Gaussian Processes-Long Short-Term Memory (GP-LSTM) model was suggested to learn the LSTM kernels and predict the nickel prices. However, this kernel function representation was not plenty for a huge amount of data captured from various sources. Also, it cannot completely learn dynamic, composite and structural data attributes. Therefore in this article, a Multiple-Kernel LSTM (MKLSTM) network model is proposed for learning the huge amount of data and predicting the nickel prices efficiently. The core objective of this MKLSTM model is to resolve the difficulty of adding LSTM and multiple kernel functions using data from nickel industries. This model is applied to find the significant attributes for representing suitable data. Also, the proper larger kernels for learning dynamic and structural data attributes are selected by constructing a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). By using the selected kernels, the MKLSTM is learned to predict the nickel price and its fluctuations. At last, the experimental results exhibit the performance of MKLSTM using the nickel price database compared to the LSTM and GP-LSTM models.
